defaultKwargs.description: The default kwargs for this embedder. Caller-provided kwargs values will be merged and take precedence.

title:
The base interface for embedders, used to encode text into embedding vectors that can be used
for retrieval, clustering, and more.

Embedders should always be {@link initialize}d before use, because most will require loading a model.
For the same reason, embedders should generally be used in an {@link Engine}, whether that's standalone
{@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Engine} or as part of another engine.
name: GenaiCore.Embedder
